items.name: Maha Shivratri
items.description: The grandest celebration at Ashram Jhadheena. All-night four-prahar Rudrabhishekam with milk, honey, bilva leaves, and sacred chants. Thousands gather for the divine darshan and midnight mahapuja.

items.name: Pavitra Shravan Maas
items.description: The entire holy month is celebrated with devotional fervor as cool monsoon showers wash the temple courtyard. Kanwariyas and pilgrims arrive carrying holy Gangajal to bathe the sacred Shivling.

items.name: Guru Purnima
items.description: Devotees from across the country congregate to bow at the holy feet of Shree Baba Sidhnath Ji and the revered Guru Parampara, renewing vows of selfless service, humility, and inner meditation.

items.name: Sidhnath Varshik Bhandara
items.description: A continuous 24-hour feast of divine consecrated food (Mahaprasad) offered to all without distinction of caste, creed, or status. The ashram echoes with kirtans and joyful community seva.

items.name: Diwali — Festival of Divine Light
items.description: Thousands of oil diyas are lit across every surface of the ashram — the marble mandapa, the ancient tree base, the archway, and the samadhi shrines — creating a breathtaking ocean of golden light. Lakshmi puja, fireworks, and free laddoo prasad distribution mark this sacred evening of light, abundance, and gratitude.
